senses.gloss: (b. h.; חול I or חלל; cmp. גלל, גל)sand, sand-region, esp. the sand used for glass-making.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ הדק</he> fine sand (marl used for manure); <he>ח׳ הגס</he> coarse sand (for cementing).
Meg. 6ᵃ, v. זְכוּכִית. [Sabb. 90ᵃ בורית זה ח׳, v. אֳהָל.]—Pl. חוֹלוֹת sandy region, sea-shore, desert.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:2">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>בין הח׳</he> on an oasis surrounded with sand-land.
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:8">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> Cæsarea <he>שהיא יושבת בין הח׳</he> which was situated between the sea-places, v. <cite ref="H00366"><he>חוֹלַת</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:4">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ח׳ אנטוכיא</he>, v. <cite ref="H00366"><he>חוֹלַת</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 1:2:3">Y. B. Kam. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top <he>בחופר בח׳</he> if one digs a pit in sandy ground.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 39:3">Sifré Deut. 39</cite> <he>בית הח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00357"><he>חוֹלָסִית</he></cite>.
